PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:
Relavent 5+ Years Experience.
Senior ServiceNow Developer : 2+ Years
ServiceNow Developer : 3+ 
SENIOR SERVICENOW DEVELOPER | NIELSEN: 2+ YEARS ( 2024-AUG - CURRENT)
Now Assist Change-Impact Nexus: Gen AI-driven analysis framework designed toaccelerate Major Incident resolution and slash MTTR by programmatically aligning incidenttelemetry with high-risk change initiatives executed in last 24-to-48-hour.
Intelligent RAG Auditor for Enterprise Cases: Deployed a custom RAG retriever via NASKto automate transactional Case policy Compliance audits.
Zero-Touch IT Onboarding: Automated end-to-end onboarding and offboardingworkflows via SFTP/REST APIs, eradicating manual administrative bottlenecks andreducing days of work to mere hours.
CMDB & Discovery: Configured and deployed ServiceNow Discovery while activelymaintaining CMDB Health , data accuracy, and infrastructure integrity. Successfullymanaged and maintained the CMDB.
AI-Driven Smart Route Automation: Eliminated a 15-hour manual triage delay formisrouted portal tickets. Implemented an AI-assisted(Predictive Intelligence) automationthat predicts and suggest the relevant team.
Now Assist SLA Intelligence Engine: Delivered highly efficient, AI-generated improvementsuggestions and actionable insights directly to managers, eliminating manual audit hours byremoving the need to search, open, and analyze breached tickets one by one.
Automated SAP Provisioning Engine: Integrated SAP SuccessFactors and Active Directoryto automate conditional system access. Built a zero-touch batch engine with self-healingAPI error handling, guaranteeing 100% compliance and saving 3 days of manual fulfillment.
SERVICENOW DEVELOPER | TECHMAHINDRA :3+ YEARS(2021 : 2024-AUG)
Integrations: Implemented third-party system integrations using REST Messages, InboundEmail, Integration Hub, and Scripted REST APIs secured with OAuth 2.0.
Access Control & Governance: Administered user accounts, role hierarchies, systempermissions, and Access Control Lists (ACLs) to guarantee secure platform access andgovernance.
Process Automation: Configured ServiceNow workflows, Business Rules, UI/Data Policies,Scheduled Jobs, Event and MID Servers utilizing Agile methodologies to streamline businessoperations.
Core Engineering: Automated legacy User Administration tasks via Flow Designer andconverted manual data migrations into automated workflows using Scheduled Import sets andTransform Maps.
Application Development: Designed, developed, and implemented Scoped Application &Custom ServiceNow applications, modules, meeting specific business requirements.
Troubleshooting and Optimization: Debugged and troubleshooted issues within ServiceNowapplications, providing solutions to enhance performance and user experience.
Platform Lifecycle (ServiceNow Upgrades): Prevented operational disruption during theZurich platform upgrade. Drove rigorous testing and bug remediation to ensure peakstability and zero-disruption deployments.

raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS:
Core Modules & Frameworks: ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge), CMDB, HRSD,ITOM, Service Portal, CSM, ITIL NowAssist, Framework, SDLC.
Development & Scripting: JavaScript, Client & Server-Side Scripting, Script Includes, BusinessRules, Client Scripts, Fix Script, UI Actions, HTML, Glide APIs (GlideForm, GlideUser, GlideAjax),Background Scripts, Scoped & Custom Applications.
Automation & UI Configuration: Flow Designer, ETL, Workflows, UI/Data Policies, ScheduledJobs, Record Producers, Order Guides, Reference Qualifiers, CSDM, Mapping, Widgets, SLA,Pages, Form & Field Layouts, AI Agents, Agentic Workflow, RAG, MCP, Now Assist, LLM,Predictive Intelligence, ML, Virtual Agent, Gen AI, Employee Center, Knowledge Graph, UIBuilder (UIB), App Engine Studio (AES), Platform analytics, ServiceNow Studio.
Integrations & Data Management: Integrated with Zendesk, SAP, Jira, Salesforce, AWS, Ariba,JDBC REST API, APIs (Table, Import), SSO, JSON, Workspace, Robust transform engine, AIOps,Transform Maps, Import Sets, LDAP, Data Sources, MID Server, Inbound/Outbound Email.
Platform Admin & Tools: Access Control Lists (ACL), Configuration Items (CI), ServiceNowDiscovery, Upgrades, Update Sets (Batch/Remote), Reports & Dashboards, Script Debugger,System Policies, Platform Scalability & Performance.
